assumptions: CONJECTURE: the coordinate addition map gives the translated-D3 intersection operator exact block-Hankel, approximant, or low-displacement structure not present for a matched random set.
UNTESTED: exact subtree nonemptiness can be specialized to a target without constructing a D2-length predicate vector or a dense translated-D3 polynomial.
HEURISTIC: the total displacement-generator rank and update work grow slowly enough to beat explicit D3 advice and D2 online scanning.
UNTESTED: a compact root representation restricts hereditarily to every child subset and certifies both zero and nonzero decisions without rebuilding D2-length state.
RESTRICTED THEOREM: after a D2 leaf is found, an exact Tier B terminal triple can be recovered in Theta(B) factor scans and D2 probes without explicit D3 advice.
RESTRICTED THEOREM: the exact identity-complete translated-D3 polynomial, resultant norm, and companion centralizer formulas hold over the registered oriented quadratic encoding.

NEGATIVE RESULT: the empty-generator companion-displacement interface requires the dense N2-coefficient remainder to identify its target, while the direct explicit-factor interface processes N3 translated factors; only these interfaces are rejected.
RESTRICTED THEOREM: the ordered signed three-source algebra gives an exact root-only scalar norm with complete identity, multiplicity, finite-child factorization, and terminal-witness semantics.

NEGATIVE RESULT: explicitly expanded CRT or dense sequential resultants, direct ordered-triple streams, and standard product-basis black-box determinant interfaces expose B^2 target slots or B^3 work, traffic, or vector coordinates; only these interfaces are rejected.
UNTESTED: a compact selector and scalar-only transposed norm can avoid every A_12, A_123, tuple-stream, and equivalent target-dependent boundary while preserving child values and exact certificates.
MODEL-BOUND: failure closes only the registered leaf encoding, tree, node oracle, and generator family.
TOY-EVIDENCE: any first implementation would use generated 8/10/12-bit curves and cannot establish an exponent.
falsification_conditions: The leaf encoding is not injective and its exact collision-lift state removes the claimed compression.
Identity support, target-dependent degree drop, or restriction to a child subset needs an unreported D2 or D3 membership object.
Constructing or specializing the node oracle requires Omega(B^2) target values, Omega(B^3) unreported advice, or equivalent hidden state.
The proved or measured displacement rank grows at the dense matched-control rate and the exact operation or traffic vector cannot beat the D2 scan.
Any positive or negative node predicate disagrees with exhaustive intersection, or the recovered leaf fails exact five-id witness replay.
A coordinate translation route for Q=O, S=O, S=Q, S=-Q, or ordinary addition is omitted or handled by an oracle-supplied branch bit.
Advice, offline work, bandwidth, target work, support, or full-pipeline costs fail the preregistered continuation and fixed-curve frontier gates.
interpretation_limits: This is a fixed-curve preprocessing hypothesis. It is not a single-instance ECDLP exponent claim.
A logarithmic number of oracle calls is not a logarithmic-time algorithm unless every node-oracle construction and query cost is charged.

Low displacement rank or a scalar final output is not compression by itself; generators, selector construction, every internal vector space and boundary, target specialization, child restriction, and certificates are all charged.

A relation compiler does not solve arbitrary discrete logs; generic preprocessing comparisons become cryptanalytic claims only after relation collection, rank, linear algebra, and individual descent are included.
An online win with explicit B^3 advice remains useful fixed-curve engineering evidence but cannot satisfy the stronger compressed-advice hypothesis.
hypothesis.mechanism: Index exact D2 states by an injective algebraic encoding, build a balanced subset-product tree, and test whether each node intersects the target-translated D3 set by an exact resultant or gcd predicate. Compile target-independent coordinate structure into a complete structured representation, including displacement generators and all kernel boundary data, so a positive root-to-leaf trace returns one D2 state and a charged terminal D3 witness lift without evaluating every D2 leaf.

predictions.metric: complete per-target operations, reads, writes, and live bytes versus exact D2 scanning
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x on both seeds at every development size, with exact no-hit and hit behavior

predictions.metric: total advice and peak preprocessing workspace versus compressed explicit D3
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x without moving a D2 or D3 index into pointers, caches, or target tables

predictions.metric: complete node representation, boundary data, specialization work, nonzeros, and traffic versus a cardinality- and collision-matched random D3 control
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x at every registered level without support loss; displacement rank alone cannot pass

predictions.metric: eventual fixed-curve full-pipeline preprocessing frontier ratio
predictions.minimum_effect: strict improvement only after offline work, advice bits, online work, success probability, supported targets, rank, linear algebra, and descent are all included

hypothesis.statement: At least one fixed prime-field curve and coordinate factor base admits an exact subset-norm relation compiler with target-independent advice o(B^3), target-specific state o(B^2), and online work o(B^2) for recovering one five-term witness from D2 intersect (Q-D3).

test_boundary.implementation: No implementation until the exact encoding and self-reduction lemma, node-operator definition, displacement or approximant rank bound, full object ledger, literature review, benchmark review, and red-team review pass.
